facts.fact: UCC says licensed operators must pay 2% of annual gross revenue into the Uganda Communications Universal Service and Access Fund (UCUSAF), and on 23 June 2026 MTN Uganda handed UCC a cheque for UGX 54.27 billion, up from UGX 50.55 billion in 2025; UCC says half goes to the Consolidated Fund and the balance retained by UCC supports UCUSAF; the document gives no spending figure and does not name the Act's section.
